name: De Stijl (web)
summary: Horizontal and vertical black lines, flat fields of red, yellow and blue, and white space. It came from the Dutch group around Mondrian and Van Doesburg and reduces form to its basic parts.

philosophy.core_thesis: Reduce form to the straight line and the primary colour, and a universal, harmonious order appears.
design_principles: Build each layout from straight horizontal and vertical lines only; no angle other than 0° or 90°.
Draw black lines of 6px to 12px between all colour fields.
Use only red (#D8261C), yellow (#F4C719), blue (#1D4FA8), black, white and a light grey (#E8E8E4).
Fill 60% to 75% of the page with white; colour fields cover at most 25% and one large field takes the most weight.
Place colour fields off centre and keep them unequal in size; the ratio between two adjacent fields is 1:1.6 to 1:2.4.
Set text in a geometric sans-serif at 16px; let headlines sit in a white field in lower case.
Let the lines run to the edge of the viewport and cut off at the border.
anti_patterns: Secondary colours such as green, orange or purple
Symmetric compositions with fields of equal size
Photographs with no flat field frame

layout.grid_mechanics: An asymmetric grid of unequal rectangles, made with CSS grid tracks (for example 3fr 1fr 2fr); black lines of 8px divide the tracks.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 60% to 75% of the surface is white; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Everything is orthogonal and flush left; text sits in white fields with a 24px inner margin.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px radius; the black line is the container edge.

font_pairings.note: A single-family Futura-like setting that fits the geometry of the style.
A lighter, geometric display with a firm text face.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.02em; body stays at 0; labels take +0.06em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Put a label of 12px in the corner of each colour field.

color.palette_structure: White ground, black lines, and the three primaries in small, unequal fields.
color.contrast_rules: Black on white holds 18:1; white text on blue holds at least 7:1; black on yellow holds at least 12:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque, matt fields of solid colour.

materiality.surface_simulation: Painted canvas: matt flat paint with no texture on screen.
materiality.border_rules: Black lines of 6px to 12px between fields; the outer edge of the page has no border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. Shadow offset is 0px.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Square pictograms built from straight lines at a 2px stroke, with butt caps and mitre joins, in black or on a primary field.
ornamentation_details.illustration: None; use abstract coloured fields only.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: fields resize along their own axis, one dimension at a time; no bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover fills a white field with yellow or red; active state turns it blue; the lines do not move.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels balance, rational calm and an abstract order.

use_cases: bento-like dashboards with a strong identity
avoid_when: The brand must feel warm, soft or organic.
The content is long reading with few fields.
The UI needs more than three signal colours.

modifiers.how: Remove the colour fields; keep the lines at 1px and one red accent.
Rotate the grid by 15° to 30° and add heavy type in red.
Turn the fields into cells with a 1px border and a 12px radius; keep the proportions.

pack.why: A strict, even line on a square grid with butt terminals: straight lines only, like the style itself.

ground.why: De Stijl divides the plane with black bars into fields of primary colour and white.
